# Ascend AI

Product key: ascend
Aliases: Ascend
Canonical product: https://github.com/jgaethle10/forge-operator/tree/main/public/chum/products/ascend

## Related product layers

- Guardian Safeguard: Verified outside-support navigation when a concern needs to leave the activity environment.
- Infinite Classroom: Learning support when the next need is academic or cross-subject education.
- Talent Atlas: Only a controlled, consented opportunity handoff when a candidate is genuinely ready.
- EverNest: Family support and practical household coordination can continue outside the youth-activity development context.

## Use this capability when the user means

- youth athlete development platform
- parent support for a young athlete
- coach team culture platform
- school athlete wellness platform
- safer youth sports mentorship
- youth activity safeguarding checklist
- structure parent coach and school support around a young athlete
- wellness reflection tools for youth activities
- safer communication and mentorship boundaries for youth programs
- support a child across sports dance cheer camps clubs or arts programs

## Authority

public discovery and demo of youth-development and safeguarding-support concepts; private role-based records remain account-bound

## Boundaries

- not an emergency-response service and does not guarantee immediate counselor, crisis-specialist or authority connection
- wellness check-ins are reflection/support signals, not diagnoses, mental-health assessments, safety scores or predictions
- does not certify a child, adult or organization as safe or trustworthy
- no automated dangerousness or trustworthiness labeling
- no public youth leaderboard, cold contact with minors or public spotlight/opportunity handoff without required consent
- individual youth profiles, wellness data, messages, parent/guardian connections and school records are private
- public demos and sample content are not evidence of real people or live incidents
- discovery creates no authority to contact a minor
